1.name: Executive Command Centre
1.summary: Strategic all-clinic health, intervention and executive decision control.

flows.title: Morning Executive Review
flows.purpose: Move from portfolio health to owned source actions without searching modules.
steps: Open the all-clinic Executive Health view and confirm the reporting period and data freshness.
Review Critical Attention items ordered by risk, due date and business impact.
Select a health component or clinic score and open its contributing records.
Assign, escalate or open the exact source workflow for each material exception.
Confirm that every red or amber item has an owner and due date.
Save the executive view and schedule or export the approved management pack.

flows.title: Clinic Benchmark and Intervention
flows.purpose: Compare clinics fairly and convert weak performance into governed action.
steps: Open the Clinic League Table and select the comparison period.
Compare health, compliance, workforce, training, risk and open-action measures.
Open the calculation for an outlier and confirm normalisation factors.
Create a management action with accountable owner, due date and expected outcome.
Monitor the clinic trend and linked remediation until the source records resolve.

flows.title: Cross-Location Emergency Intervention
flows.purpose: Coordinate mandatory action across affected clinics with live completion visibility.
steps: Start an Emergency Intervention from the Risk Heatmap or Critical Attention panel.
Select affected clinics, severity, local action, evidence requirement and response deadline.
Preview the local workflows that will be superseded or prioritised.
Issue the mandatory action to each Practice Manager and local owner.
Monitor acknowledgement, evidence and sign-off by clinic.
Escalate overdue or blocked responses and issue updates.
Close only after all clinics are resolved or formally escalated.

2.name: Action Inbox & Notifications
2.summary: Single queue for approvals, exceptions, escalations and owned work.

flows.title: Triage and Resolve an Action
flows.purpose: Decide from one queue with evidence, impact and source context.
steps: Open My Actions or Team Queue and apply clinic, category and priority filters.
Select an item to load the evidence, activity history and downstream impact.
Choose Approve, Request Changes, Reassign, Resolve or Open Source.
Enter the required reason where the decision changes ownership or status.
Confirm the action and verify the source record updates.
Keep the item active until the underlying requirement is genuinely satisfied.

flows.title: Automatic SLA Escalation
flows.purpose: Prevent time-sensitive work from remaining unseen or ownerless.
steps: A critical item remains unresolved beyond its configured response threshold.
The platform adds an uneditable System Timeout event and SLA Breached label.
The item routes to the next approved escalation owner while retaining the original owner.
The escalated user receives a high-priority notification with direct source link.
The user resolves or reassigns the source issue.
The full breach, escalation and response timeline remains reportable.

flows.title: Link and Deduplicate Related Alerts
flows.purpose: Reduce queue noise without deleting independent operational evidence.
steps: Select related alerts caused by one operational event.
Choose Link & Deduplicate and nominate the master operational record.
Review confidentiality and clinic permissions before linking.
Nest secondary alerts as Linked Exceptions beneath the master item.
Use the master record for shared updates while retaining each source history.
Close each linked exception only when its own outcome is satisfied.

3.name: Organisation, Locations, Users & Permissions
3.summary: Organisation structure, clinic lifecycle, access governance and business settings.

flows.title: Clinic Lifecycle Transition
flows.purpose: Open, relocate, merge, reduce or close a clinic without orphaning responsibilities.
steps: Start a Clinic Transition and select the transition type and effective date.
Complete the impact assessment across workforce, rosters, assets, stock, suppliers, communications, digital services and governance.
Assign owners, due dates, dependencies and evidence requirements.
Resolve all critical readiness blockers and approve communications.
Confirm final readiness and change the clinic status on the effective date.
Retain historical records under the originating clinic and complete a post-transition review.

flows.title: Scheduled Access Review
flows.purpose: Confirm that users retain only current role and clinic permissions.
steps: Open Access Reviews and select the clinic, scope and review period.
Review active users, last activity, sensitive permissions, temporary access and delegations.
Confirm, reduce, remove or extend access with a reason.
Route unresolved access changes to the responsible administrator.
Complete the review with sign-off and retain the decision history.

flows.title: Temporary Cross-Clinic Access
flows.purpose: Support short-term workforce sharing without permanent permission growth.
steps: Open the worker profile and select Grant Temporary Cross-Access.
Choose the destination clinic, role scope, permitted workspaces and hard expiry.
Preview what the worker can view, create, approve and export.
Obtain approval where the scope is sensitive or broad.
Activate the temporary access and label actions completed under it.
Terminate access automatically at expiry and include it in the next access review.

4.name: Staff & Doctor Management
4.summary: Effective-dated workforce profiles, readiness, contracts, credentials and lifecycle changes.

flows.title: Onboard and Activate a Worker
flows.purpose: Create a complete workforce profile and prevent premature roster or pay use.
steps: Create the staff or doctor profile and record identity, role, clinics and start date.
Complete contract, award, payment and credential sections appropriate to the person type.
Review the role-based mandatory document and training checklist.
Assign missing onboarding actions to responsible owners.
Verify sensitive bank, contract and credential information.
Activate the profile only when mandatory readiness is complete or an authorised exception exists.

flows.title: Credential Suspension and Reactivation
flows.purpose: Apply immediate operational controls when mandatory evidence expires or changes.
steps: Open the credential alert and review the affected duties, clinics and future shifts.
Select Suspend Eligibility and enter the business justification.
Reassign affected shifts and block new duty or pay actions where the approved rule requires.
Receive and review replacement evidence.
Approve or reject the renewal with effective date.
Reactivate only the duties supported by the approved credential.

flows.title: Employment or Contract Change
flows.purpose: Implement role, rate, clinic or contract changes without overwriting history.
steps: Start Employment Change or Contract Change from the profile.
Select the change type, effective date and reason.
Review impacts on access, roster eligibility, training, award rules, pay and approvals.
Complete required approvals and supporting documents.
Activate the new version on the approved date.
Retain the former version and generate prior-period adjustment actions when retrospective.

5.name: Roster & Shift Management
5.summary: High-density, shift-first workforce planning with eligibility, fatigue, cost and dissemination controls.

flows.title: High-Density Bulk Roster Generation
flows.purpose: Build required coverage first and assign compliant staff at scale.
steps: Open the high-density location grid and choose clinics and roster period.
Apply an approved coverage template to create unassigned shift blocks.
Select multiple shifts and open Assignment Intelligence.
Rank staff by role, access, availability, hours, fatigue, award impact, training and credentials.
Bulk assign selected workers and recalculate conflicts and cost.
Resolve blockers or request a scoped authorised override.
Publish and disseminate the validated roster with acknowledgement tracking.

flows.title: Open Shift and Urgent Coverage
flows.purpose: Fill a planned or sudden vacancy using a governed offer process.
steps: Convert the uncovered shift into an Open Shift with response deadline.
Filter eligible workers by role, clinic access, availability, training and current hours.
Choose the offer audience and send the coverage request.
Review acceptances and select the final worker where several respond.
Run roster validation and transfer opening, closing or checklist duties.
Confirm assignment and notify all affected users.

flows.title: Roster Compliance Override
flows.purpose: Allow exceptional coverage only after transparent risk and authority review.
steps: Validate the roster and open a blocking conflict.
Review the violated rule, affected worker, cost and fatigue impact.
Select Request Authorised Override and enter the business case and control.
Route the request to the approved Operations Manager.
Approve, reject or request changes.
Embed the approved justification in the published shift history.

6.name: Time & Attendance
6.summary: Approved-terminal attendance, breaks, exceptions, offline capture and timesheet readiness.

flows.title: Standard Attendance Capture
flows.purpose: Record actual work against an approved shift with clear next actions.
steps: Open My Clock on an approved clinic terminal.
Confirm the rostered shift, clinic and current attendance state.
Record clock-in, break and clock-out events.
Review the completed shift summary.
Route any missing or inconsistent event to the exception queue.
Move a clean record to timesheet review.

flows.title: Offline Capture and Reconciliation
flows.purpose: Preserve low-risk attendance events during connectivity loss without treating them as confirmed.
steps: The interface enters visible Offline Mode and limits available actions.
The worker records an approved attendance event locally.
The event is labelled Pending Reconciliation with local timestamp.
On restoration, match the event to roster and current access.
Route duplicates, overlaps or changed assignments to the manager.
Approve, correct or reject the event and refresh the timesheet.

flows.title: Temporary Mobile Clocking and Location Review
flows.purpose: Support field work while preventing unrestricted mobile attendance.
steps: Manager grants a worker a time-limited mobile clocking profile for an approved purpose.
The worker clocks from the mobile interface during the approved window.
The platform checks expected time and location.
A mismatch enters the attendance Exceptions workspace.
Manager reviews the context and records the business justification.
The event is approved or rejected and the override expires automatically.

7.name: Staff Pay & Payroll Preparation
7.summary: Payroll readiness, variance review, export, reconciliation, correction and final-pay control.

flows.title: Prepare and Approve a Pay Run
flows.purpose: Convert approved time and leave into a payroll-ready output without replacing payroll.
steps: Create the pay run for the selected period.
Load approved attendance, leave and effective classification mappings.
Review clinic and employee readiness.
Resolve source exceptions through linked records.
Recalculate totals and investigate material variances.
Approve each clinic and submit the full run for final review.

flows.title: Export Rejection and Replacement
flows.purpose: Correct mapping errors without altering locked timesheet history.
steps: Export the approved run to the payroll process.
Receive an Export Failed state with employee-level reasons.
Open the reconciliation panel and map the external rejection to the relevant award or identity setting.
Correct the configuration while preserving original approved time.
Generate a replacement export version.
Reconcile and lock the successful output while retaining the rejected version.

flows.title: Final Pay and Prior-Period Correction
flows.purpose: Complete offboarding and pay corrections with clear history and authority.
steps: Open the final-pay action generated by offboarding or a discovered variance.
Review approved hours, leave, allowances and outstanding corrections.
Record the correction or final-pay method and required communication.
Obtain authorised approval.
Process the adjustment in the appropriate payroll period or external workflow.
Link original, replacement and correction records and complete reconciliation.

8.name: Doctor Pay Command Centre
8.summary: Multi-clinic doctor activity reconciliation, contract calculation, payslips, disputes and manual payment recording.

flows.title: Consolidated Doctor Pay Run
flows.purpose: Create one controlled pay result while preserving clinic-level detail.
steps: Select the payment cycle and import approved activity summaries from each clinic.
Match transactions to the doctor, clinic and effective contract rule.
Resolve duplicates, exclusions and unmatched activity.
Calculate service fee, GST and approved adjustments by clinic.
Reconcile clinic totals into the consolidated provider statement.
Submit for approval, generate the payslip and publish it to the doctor portal.
Record the external manual bank transfer and lock the completed run.

flows.title: Doctor Pay Query and Correction
flows.purpose: Resolve a doctor concern without silently changing an approved run.
steps: Doctor raises a query from the exact payslip or transaction.
Finance categorises and accepts the case.
Review source activity, contract terms and prior adjustments.
Request further information or reopen the run through the authorised correction process.
Generate and publish a new version where the financial result changes.
Send the resolution and close only when the outcome is confirmed.

flows.title: Failed, Returned or Partial Payment
flows.purpose: Keep payslip approval, delivery and payment exception states separate but linked.
steps: Record the failed, returned or partial manual transfer.
Verify current approved bank details and the affected amount.
Record the paid amount and keep any outstanding balance open.
Complete the replacement transfer outside MCOP.
Record the new payment reference and date.
Notify the doctor and close the exception with full history.

9.name: BBPIP Forecast & Reconciliation
9.summary: Incentive forecasting, contribution analysis, evidence gaps and final outcome reconciliation.

flows.title: Create and Approve a Forecast
flows.purpose: Create an explainable estimate using approved operational summaries.
steps: Select the incentive period and refresh approved source summaries.
Review completeness, eligibility assumptions and blocking data gaps.
Run the forecast by clinic and doctor.
Inspect contribution, confidence and assumptions.
Submit the estimate for review.
Approve the current management baseline and retain its version.

flows.title: Resolve an Eligibility or Evidence Gap
flows.purpose: Convert a forecast weakness into owned evidence work.
steps: Open the Compliance Gaps queue.
Select the gap and review its affected period and estimated value.
Assign an owner and due date or link approved evidence.
Review the submitted evidence.
Mark the gap Resolved or Not Applicable with reason.
Refresh the forecast confidence and values.

flows.title: Reconcile the Actual Incentive Outcome
flows.purpose: Explain the difference between forecast and approved actual result.
steps: Enter or import the approved actual outcome.
Compare it with the latest approved forecast.
Classify each material variance.
Attach supporting evidence and commentary.
Obtain reconciliation approval.
Finalise and lock the period with accuracy reporting.

10.name: Tasks, Checklists, Meetings & Actions
10.summary: Daily work, room controls, handovers, meetings and accountable action closure.

flows.title: Create, Publish and Execute a Checklist
flows.purpose: Turn a controlled template into role, room or shift-specific operational evidence.
steps: Create or select a checklist template.
Define location, room, role, frequency, item types and evidence rules.
Preview assignments and publish a version.
The assigned user completes the occurrence in My Day.
A failed or skipped item captures reason and can create a ticket or incident.
Manager reviews exceptions and closes the occurrence with its true outcome.

flows.title: Daily and Shift Handover
flows.purpose: Transfer unresolved operational responsibility without treating acknowledgement as completion.
steps: Outgoing user creates a handover.
The platform suggests open tasks, incidents, tickets, stock issues and checklist failures.
User confirms relevant items and assigns incoming owners.
Incoming users acknowledge receipt.
High-risk unacknowledged items escalate.
The handover closes when acknowledgement is complete while source actions remain open.

flows.title: Practice Scale-Up or Scale-Down Checklist
flows.purpose: Control clinic, room or service changes through protected milestones and local actions.
steps: Start a Structural Change Directive and select the change type and effective date.
Load protected milestones covering workforce, rooms, assets, finance, communications and governance.
Append local actions without removing mandatory requirements.
Track owner, due date, evidence and dependencies.
Complete verification review and resolve blocking milestones.
Approve activation and schedule post-change review.

11.name: Training & Learning Management
11.summary: Role-based learning, competency, acknowledgement, exemption and quality-triggered remediation.

flows.title: Create and Assign Learning
flows.purpose: Publish versioned content and assign it by role, clinic or responsibility.
steps: Create the course, acknowledgement or competency requirement.
Define content, assessment, pass rule, validity and evidence.
Select assignment rules and preview affected users.
Publish the learning version.
Users complete content and assessment.
Record completion, failure, certificate and next renewal.

flows.title: Exemption and Prior Learning
flows.purpose: Recognise valid existing evidence without hiding the difference from completion.
steps: User requests an exemption against a specific requirement.
Submit issuing body, evidence, completion date and validity.
Training administrator compares evidence with the requirement.
Approve, reject or request more information.
Apply the exemption until its expiry or review date.
Retain exemption and completion as distinct reportable outcomes.

flows.title: Automated Quality Assurance Training Escalation
flows.purpose: Respond to repeated operational errors with targeted remediation and controlled sign-off.
steps: Approved error thresholds are reached for a user and duty.
A high-priority quality action appears for the manager.
Manager reviews contributing records and confirms the competency issue.
Mandatory corrective training is assigned and readiness changes to Review Required.
Affected high-risk sign-off is temporarily restricted.
User completes training and observed assessment.
Manager verifies readiness and restores the scoped permission.

12.name: Accreditation, Quality & Regulatory Compliance
12.summary: RACGP readiness, evidence, cold chain, audits, QI and regulatory action.

flows.title: Accreditation Readiness Review
flows.purpose: Explain readiness and drive every gap to evidence or owned action.
steps: Open Compliance Centre and select organisation or clinic.
Review readiness by training, documents, policies, cold chain, QI and audit findings.
Open a Critical or Attention Required component.
Assign or review the contributing action and required evidence.
Submit evidence for independent review.
Confirm the requirement Met or return it with comments.

flows.title: Cold-Chain Exception
flows.purpose: Contain and investigate an out-of-range reading while preserving evidence.
steps: Record the scheduled temperature reading.
An out-of-range value opens the exception workflow.
Record device, time, stock impact and immediate containment.
Create a ticket or incident where required.
Manager records stock disposition and corrective action.
Close after review and include the event in compliance trends.

flows.title: Audit Finding to Verified Closure
flows.purpose: Convert an audit observation into controlled corrective action and retained evidence.
steps: Record the audit finding, risk and affected requirement.
Assign corrective and preventive actions.
Link policy, training, checklist or ticket changes.
Track evidence and due dates.
Reviewer verifies effectiveness, not just task completion.
Close the finding and update readiness and recurrence reporting.

13.name: Documents, Policies, SOPs & Intake
13.summary: Controlled intake, classification, review, publication, acknowledgement, retention and legal hold.

flows.title: Process Document Intake
flows.purpose: Prevent incoming business records from remaining ownerless or unclassified.
steps: Open the Intake Queue and select the incoming item.
Review preview, suggested category, sensitivity and possible source module.
Confirm clinic, owner, classification and retention category.
File the record, create an action or reject it as duplicate or irrelevant.
Route required review to the Action Inbox.
Record the final destination and processing outcome.

flows.title: Publish a Controlled Policy or SOP
flows.purpose: Create an approved version with effective date, acknowledgement and superseded history.
steps: Create from template or upload a draft.
Complete metadata, roles, clinics, owner, effective and review dates.
Submit to reviewers and resolve comments.
Approve the exact version.
Publish and assign acknowledgements where required.
Mark the prior version Superseded and retain full history.

flows.title: Retention, Legal Hold and Disposal
flows.purpose: Control end-of-life decisions without destroying held or required records.
steps: A record reaches its retention review date.
Owner reviews category, business need, linked matters and hold status.
Choose Retain, Extend, Archive, Dispose or Place on Legal Hold.
Obtain approval for sensitive or bulk disposal.
Record disposal authority and evidence or maintain the hold.
Return released holds to review rather than deleting automatically.

14.name: Ticketing Desk & Work Orders
14.summary: Issue intake, triage, SLA, work orders, duplicates, contractors and evidence-based closure.

flows.title: Report and Resolve an Operational Issue
flows.purpose: Move from staff report to evidence-based manager closure.
steps: Report the issue or scan the linked asset.
Capture clinic, room, asset, impact, urgency and evidence.
Triage priority and assign an owner.
Owner accepts work and records updates.
Attach completion evidence and mark work complete.
Manager signs off or returns the ticket for further work.

flows.title: Vendor Work Order and Contractor Visit
flows.purpose: Govern scope, cost, access and completion for external work.
steps: Create a work order from the ticket.
Define scope, supplier, access window, quote and safety requirements.
Obtain cost approval where required.
Check in the contractor and confirm permitted areas.
Record work, parts, evidence and scope changes.
Check out, test the asset and complete manager sign-off.

flows.title: Duplicate Detection and Master Ticket
flows.purpose: Consolidate service restoration while preserving every original report.
steps: A new ticket displays possible duplicates based on clinic, asset and timing.
Triage compares the reports and selects Merge as Duplicate.
Choose the master ticket and confirm confidentiality compatibility.
Manage assignment, SLA and work order from the master.
Keep duplicate reporters informed.
Close linked duplicates when the master and their own outcome are satisfied.

15.name: Inventory, Suppliers, Finance & Assets
15.summary: Stock, suppliers, invoices, assets, equipment, printers, service and recall control.

flows.title: Low-Stock Reorder and Receipt
flows.purpose: Replenish below-PAR stock with approval and discrepancy control.
steps: Review items below PAR by clinic and criticality.
Create a purchase request grouped by supplier.
Review quantities, expected cost and approval threshold.
Approve and issue the order.
Receive delivered quantities and record discrepancies.
Update balances and retain the movement and approval history.

flows.title: Expiry, Batch Recall and Product Disposition
flows.purpose: Locate, quarantine and resolve affected stock across all clinics.
steps: Select the affected item or batch.
Identify quantities by clinic and room.
Quarantine stock and prevent normal use.
Assign local verification actions.
Record return, transfer, write-off or approved disposition.
Close only when every known location is resolved or escalated.

flows.title: Asset Assignment, Service and Retirement
flows.purpose: Maintain one accountable owner or location throughout the asset lifecycle.
steps: Create or select the asset and confirm criticality and service rules.
Assign or loan it to a person, clinic or room.
Track service, calibration, warranty and linked faults.
Inspect and record condition on transfer or return.
For loss or theft, create linked incident and access actions.
For retirement, confirm data removal, disposal approval and final status.

16.name: Incidents, Complaints, Risk & Continuity
16.summary: Confidential reporting, triage, investigation, RCA/CAPA, enterprise risk and continuity.

flows.title: Report, Investigate and Close an Incident
flows.purpose: Capture facts quickly, protect confidentiality and verify corrective action effectiveness.
steps: Reporter records category, clinic, time, immediate risk and immediate action.
Triage assigns severity, confidentiality and investigator.
Investigator builds chronology, evidence and contributing factors.
Create corrective and preventive actions with owners and due dates.
Verify actions and effectiveness.
Submit closure for authorised review and retain lessons and trends.

flows.title: Complaint Response and Escalation
flows.purpose: Manage service concerns, recovery and review without unnecessary clinical detail.
steps: Log the complaint, preferred contact channel, acknowledgement due date and owner.
Acknowledge and investigate the service concern.
Record communication and recovery actions.
Link an incident where risk or serious harm is identified.
Approve the response and outcome.
Open an independent review if the complainant remains dissatisfied.

flows.title: Business Continuity Event or Exercise
flows.purpose: Activate a usable playbook, restore service and reconcile backlog.
steps: Select a scenario and choose Live Event or Exercise.
Record affected clinic, services, impact and decision owner.
Assign roles, contacts, workaround checklists and communications.
Update risk and service status during the event.
Confirm restoration and identify backlog.
Reconcile backlog and complete the post-event review and actions.

17.name: Email & SMS Communications
17.summary: Approved campaigns, emergency communication, audience governance, consent and delivery.

flows.title: Create, Approve and Send a Campaign
flows.purpose: Send approved operational communication with audience and consent controls.
steps: Create the email or SMS campaign and select purpose and clinic scope.
Choose an approved audience source and exclusions.
Select a template and edit permitted content.
Preview desktop, mobile or SMS segments and send a test.
Submit the exact content and audience version for approval.
Schedule or send and monitor delivery results.

flows.title: Failed Delivery Review
flows.purpose: Retry eligible failures without duplicating successful sends.
steps: Open Delivery and filter Failed.
Group failures by invalid contact, suppression, temporary failure or provider issue.
Retry eligible temporary failures.
Create source-correction actions for permanent failures.
Keep successful recipients excluded from retry.
Report original and retry outcomes accurately.

flows.title: Emergency Update and All-Clear
flows.purpose: Issue urgent operational messages linked to the source event.
steps: Select the approved emergency template and linked incident or outage.
Confirm clinics, audience, exclusions and channels.
Complete the urgent approval.
Send the initial message and prioritise failures.
Issue linked updates as conditions change.
Send the all-clear and retain one event history.

18.name: Digital Operations & Security
18.summary: Digital availability, remote support, privileged access, secrets, cameras and review.

flows.title: Website or Digital-Service Outage
flows.purpose: Acknowledge, restore and learn from repeated service failure.
steps: Repeated monitoring failures create an outage alert.
IT reviews response history, affected site and service impact.
Acknowledge and create the linked ticket or incident.
Record containment, updates and recovery time.
Confirm restoration and close the source issue.
Update uptime and recurrence reporting.

flows.title: Remote Access Request and Session
flows.purpose: Limit support access by purpose, asset, clinic and time.
steps: Support user selects an approved endpoint.
Request access with purpose, duration and related ticket.
Approver reviews sensitivity and narrows scope if required.
Launch the approved session and record start.
End the session and record outcome.
Review any emergency or unusual access.

flows.title: Secret or Camera Access
flows.purpose: Apply explicit purpose and approval to sensitive access and export.
steps: User requests a secret reveal or camera footage action.
Record system or zone, purpose, time range and linked matter.
Approver reviews authority, privacy and minimum necessary scope.
Grant time-limited viewing, copy or export.
Log the action and required retention.
Create credential rotation or follow-up action where needed.

19.name: Clinic Analytics, Data Quality & Change
19.summary: Trusted operational insight, all-clinic benchmarking, data correction and governed change.

flows.title: Review Clinic Performance and Create Action
flows.purpose: Use comparable metrics to identify and improve operational outliers.
steps: Select the clinic, period and comparison cohort.
Review metric definition, threshold, exclusions and freshness.
Open an outlier and inspect contributing operational summaries.
Create an action with owner, due date and expected measure.
Track the action through the Action Inbox.
Review the subsequent trend and close when the outcome is verified.

flows.title: Correct a Critical Data-Quality Issue
flows.purpose: Fix missing, stale or duplicate source information without erasing history.
steps: Open Data Quality and filter Critical.
Review the source record and downstream workflows affected.
Correct, merge or submit the record for specialist review.
Obtain confirmation for sensitive or high-impact corrections.
Run the next quality check.
Clear the exception and update the clinic data-health score.

flows.title: Business Change, Rollback and Benefits Review
flows.purpose: Implement change with readiness and recover safely when results are poor.
steps: Raise the change with outcome, clinics and effective date.
Assess impacts across people, policy, training, communications, finance and continuity.
Assign actions and obtain approval.
Confirm readiness and implement.
If unsafe or unsuccessful, Pause, Rollback or Correct Forward.
Stabilise service and complete the expected-versus-actual benefits review.

20.name: Commercial SaaS & Organisation Workspaces
20.summary: Tenant onboarding, plan governance, support access, usage, billing, renewal and offboarding.

flows.title: Onboard and Activate a Tenant
flows.purpose: Configure a customer group with clear ownership, training and acceptance.
steps: Create the tenant identity, contacts, contract dates and support owner.
Select the plan and enabled modules.
Invite the tenant administrator.
Complete clinic, user, configuration, training and sample-workflow tasks.
Review acceptance evidence and unresolved gaps.
Activate the tenant and schedule adoption review.

flows.title: Plan Upgrade, Downgrade or Billing Recovery
flows.purpose: Change commercial entitlement without removing historical records.
steps: Open the current plan and select the proposed change.
Review gained or lost modules, limits, price and effective date.
Identify records or exports required before downgrade.
Complete customer and internal approvals.
Apply the change on the approved date.
For failed payment, communicate, restrict or reinstate according to contract.

flows.title: Tenant-Approved Support Access
flows.purpose: Allow support investigation only for an approved ticket, scope and duration.
steps: Support requests access from the customer case.
Specify tenant, modules, purpose, data scope and expiry.
Tenant administrator approves, limits or rejects.
Display a visible support-access banner during the period.
Complete support work and record outcome.
Expire access automatically and include it in review history.

21.name: SaaS Vendor Operations & Tenant Provisioning
21.summary: Vendor-level provisioning, entitlement, service status and support governance outside tenant operations.

flows.title: Provision a New Medical Group Tenant
flows.purpose: Create the commercial tenant shell and hand control to the client administrator.
steps: Open Vendor Command Console and select Provision New Tenant.
Record corporate identity, primary contact, country and contract reference.
Select subscription tier and module entitlements.
Review provisioning checklist and commercial approval.
Confirm provisioning and create the Pending Activation tenant.
Send the administrator invitation and monitor activation.

flows.title: Commercial Suspension and Reinstatement
flows.purpose: Apply contractual restriction while preserving records and essential closure options.
steps: Open the tenant commercial status.
Review failed payment, contract status and customer communication.
Submit the suspension decision for authority.
Apply the approved restriction and notify the tenant.
Keep permitted export, support and resolution actions available.
After resolution, reinstate and record the outcome.

flows.title: Portfolio Service-Impact Coordination
flows.purpose: Communicate and manage a multi-tenant service issue without exposing customer information.
steps: Service monitoring identifies a cross-tenant impact.
Vendor operations creates the service event and severity.
Publish an approved portfolio bulletin without tenant-confidential detail.
Track affected components, workarounds and restoration.
Issue updates and the all-clear.
Complete a post-incident summary and prevention actions.

22.name: Recruitment & Talent Acquisition
22.summary: Vacancies, tenant-controlled applications, candidate Kanban, assessment, offers and promotion to staff.

flows.title: Create and Publish a Vacancy
flows.purpose: Approve role need and publish a consistent tenant-controlled application experience.
steps: Create a vacancy from an approved job template.
Record clinic, employment type, owner, hours, credentials and closing date.
Preview public content and screening questions.
Submit for approval and resolve changes.
Publish and generate the external application link.
Monitor applications and vacancy ageing.

flows.title: Review, Interview and Offer
flows.purpose: Progress candidates consistently using structured evidence and authority.
steps: Review new applications and completeness.
Shortlist or request more information.
Schedule structured interview and panel.
Record assessment, references and comparison.
Submit the preferred offer for approval.
Issue the offer and record acceptance, decline or withdrawal.

flows.title: Candidate-to-Employee Transition
flows.purpose: Create a workforce profile without losing or mutating the recruitment history.
steps: Open an accepted candidate and select Promote to Staff Profile.
Review mapped identity, role, clinic and start details.
Identify missing workforce readiness information.
Confirm promotion and create the Draft staff profile.
Lock the candidate history as Promoted to Staff.
Complete normal onboarding, access, training and activation.

23.name: Tenant Website Infrastructure & SEO Engine
23.summary: Modular website assembly, local SEO, public form routing, publication and rollback governance.

flows.title: Assemble and Publish a Tenant Website
flows.purpose: Publish responsive clinic-safe content using approved modules and source details.
steps: Create the site from the tenant brand and base template.
Add clinic pages and approved components.
Link current clinic details, services, profiles and booking destinations.
Preview desktop and mobile.
Run accessibility, SEO and source-consistency checks.
Submit for approval and publish the approved version.

flows.title: Local SEO Review
flows.purpose: Keep search-facing clinic details complete and consistent with the approved clinic profile.
steps: Open the clinic page in SEO Visibility Control.
Review title, description, address, phone, hours and service categories.
Resolve mismatches and duplicate content.
Preview the search result.
Submit the exact changes for approval.
Publish and monitor completeness and visibility trends.

flows.title: Create and Route a Public Form
flows.purpose: Collect minimum necessary public information and convert it to an owned operational action.
steps: Choose the approved public form purpose.
Add only necessary fields and the privacy notice.
Select clinic, destination queue, owner, acknowledgement and SLA.
Preview and review privacy and routing.
Publish the form.
Create an intake or Action Inbox item for each submission and escalate routing failures.

24.name: Practice Financial Forecast & Ledger Control
24.summary: Multi-clinic revenue, expense, roster-cost, margin baseline and actual-versus-forecast control.

flows.title: Initialize and Lock a Fiscal Forecast
flows.purpose: Create an explainable multi-clinic baseline from approved operational summaries.
steps: Select clinics, fiscal period and historical comparison.
Load approved doctor pay, staff pay, incentive and cost summaries.
Add structural revenue and expense assumptions.
Resolve missing or unmapped configuration.
Compare expected, conservative and stress scenarios.
Submit, approve and lock the immutable baseline.

flows.title: Predictive Roster Labour-Cost Check
flows.purpose: Prevent roster publication from exceeding an approved labour threshold without authority.
steps: Open the roster grid with the clinic budget loaded.
Assign shifts and watch real-time labour cost and ratio.
Open the contributing cost breakdown when the threshold is exceeded.
Adjust coverage or request an over-budget override.
Approver reviews service need, cost and operational risk.
Release only the approved roster version and amount.

flows.title: Actual versus Forecast Reconciliation
flows.purpose: Detect, own and remediate material financial variance without changing the baseline.
steps: Import the approved external accounting summary.
Map actual lines to forecast categories.
Overlay actual values against the locked baseline.
Create actions for material negative or positive variances.
Record cause, recovery plan, owner and due date.
Reconcile the period while retaining baseline, actual and remediation history.
